events.name: Bash
events.head: Check origin/main, live mirror repo state, and publish holds
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git log -1 --format='%h %ci %s' origin/main; git merge-base --is-ancestor 757b2ecd origin/main && echo "757b in origin/main"; ls -d live 2>&1; cd live 2>/dev/null && git fetch -q && git log -3 --format='%h %ci %s' origin/HEAD; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live status --short | head -5; grep -in "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect live mirror commits and main changes since last publish
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live; git branch --show-current; git log -4 --format='%h %ci %s' ; git status -sb|head -2; grep -rl "757b2ecd\|c3c56128" ../workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | head; grep -n "c3c56128\|06f00427" ../workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; cd ..; git log --oneline 06f00427..origin/main -- app/src | wc -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find last site publish commit and main changes since
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live; git log --format='%h %ci %s' -- site | head -5; git log --all --format='%h %s' | grep -i "c3c56128\|from main\|publish" | head -5; cd ..; git log --oneline 06f00427..origin/main -- app/src app/public | head; git merge-base --is-ancestor 757b2ecd 06f00427 && echo "757b in 06f00427"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Diff masterclass sources since publish; check live share card
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git diff --stat 06f00427 origin/main -- app/src/app/masterclass app/src/app/vip app/src/lib app/src/components/masterclass app/src/app/layout.tsx | tail -5; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/masterclass/?v=$(date +%s)" > /tmp/t001mc.html; grep -o '<meta property="og:[a-z]*" content="[^"]*"' /tmp/t001mc.html | head -4; grep -o '<title>[^<]*' /tmp/t001mc.html; grep -oi 'What you keep' /tmp/t001mc.html | head -1; grep -ioc '50M\|refund\|money-back\|webinar' /tmp/t001mc.html

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate flagged words and "What you keep" copy
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -io '.\{80\}\(50M\|refund\|money-back\|webinar\).\{80\}' /tmp/t001mc.html | head -3; grep -rn "What you keep" app/src --include=*.ts* | head -3; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/?v=$(date +%s)" > /tmp/t001vip.html; grep -ioc 'What you keep' /tmp/t001vip.html; grep -io '.\{60\}\(50M\|refund\|money-back\|webinar\).\{60\}' /tmp/t001vip.html | head -3

events.text: Status: the mirror already has the T-477 publish (from main 06f00427, which includes the 757b2ecd share card). Now I'm checking whether the newer main commits matter and running the probes.
